comments.story: Wind provided 37 per cent of Ireland’s electricity in Q1 2019
comments.why: Episode on a wind farm paying off its CO2 debt in 45 days.
comments.text: There's a Fully Charged episode on Youtube that looked into this. Hammer's Hill Wind Farm on Orkney paid off their installation and construction CO2 debt in the first 45 days of operation. Despite there being 500 tons of concrete and steel in each base. [VIDEO]

comments.author: ZeroGravitas
comments.story: Tesla runs an entire island on solar power
comments.why: Orkney as a test site with wind, heat pumps, wave power and batteries.
comments.text: The island of Orkney is also doing similar, and is used as some kind of test site for the tech I think: [VIDEO] It has wind power, sea water sourced heat pumps, a little bit of solar, a test rig for underwater wave power, batteries that are used to relieve the peaks on energy transmission to the mainland and projects to increase electric car uptake to soak up excess energy production.
